_schema.description: Summary of htv.json: coverage counts, per-area counts and, per district, where Labor's, the Liberals', the Nationals', One Nation's and the Greens' cards put Labor, the Coalition, the Greens and One Nation. Generated by scripts/vec_htv.py.

fields.areas: {area id: {house, cards, read, same_as, unreadable, parties: {code: cards}, no_card}}
fields.htv/<area>.json: {area, house, name, status, source_url, registration_closes, ballot: [candidates in ballot order], groups (Council), cards: [each card with this area's order, as in htv.json], no_card: [ballot names], labor_greens (seats whose page says which of Labor or the Greens each card ranks higher: why the seat is listed)}
fields.watch: [{area, party, cards, read, ranks (when every read card agrees), differ, flags, flags_some, card_url}]
